title: FERN: Cross-Benchmark Table Retrieval for Text-to-SQL with Frozen Retrievers and Learned Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2611.14477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems over large pooled catalogs must first retrieve the tables a question needs. We compare against the published table recall of RASL, which uses Claude 3.5 models to extract keywords and select tables, on pooled BIRD, Spider, and Fiben catalogs. FERN (Feature-Engineered Ranking with No generative LLM) instead fuses three frozen retrievers into 100 candidates, describes each with up to 120 features, and reorders them with LightGBM rankers fitted once on BIRD's training questions. On Spider, where it was not fitted, its candidate pool alone reaches RASL's published recall at fifteen tables (98.0), and the ranker raises the share of questions with every gold table in the top five (complete@5) from 83.9% to 95.6%. At five tables, FERN's recall is within one point of RASL's on Spider (96.7 vs 97.0) and on BIRD with its evidence hints (96.6 vs 97.5), and 8.2 points below on BIRD without them (89.3). translated_title: FERN：基于冻结检索器与学习排序的跨基准Text-to-SQL表格检索
translated_abstract: 在大型合并目录上运行的Text-to-SQL系统必须首先检索出问题所需的表格。我们在合并的BIRD、Spider和Fiben目录上，与RASL已发表的表格召回率进行了比较，RASL使用Claude 3.5模型来提取关键词并选择表格。FERN（无需生成式大语言模型的特征工程排序）则将三个冻结的检索器融合生成100个候选表格，用多达120个特征来描述每个候选，并使用仅在BIRD训练问题上拟合一次的LightGBM排序器对其进行重新排序。在未参与拟合的Spider数据集上，仅其候选池在15个表格处就达到了RASL已发表的召回率（98.0），且排序器将在前五名中包含所有标准表格的问题比例（complete@5）从83.9%提升至95.6%。在5个表格设置下，FERN在Spider上的召回率与RASL相差不到一个百分点（96.7对97.0），在带有证据提示的BIRD上也相差不到一个百分点（96.6对97.5），而在不带证据提示的BIRD上低8.2个百分点（89.3）。在121个真实BEAVER问题上……
tldr: FERN不使用任何生成式大语言模型，仅通过融合三个冻结检索器生成候选表格并用LightGBM学习排序器重排，在跨基准的Text-to-SQL表格检索任务上达到了与依赖Claude 3.5的RASL相近的召回率，且无需针对新基准重新训练。
en_tdlr: FERN matches the recall of RASL (which relies on Claude 3.5) in cross-benchmark table retrieval for Text-to-SQL by fusing three frozen retrievers to generate candidates and applying a LightGBM learned ranker, entirely without generative LLMs.
